No TODO: implement test left in the spec

result.summary: Read test/specs/REQ-049.md and test/letflow/engine/variable_merge_test.exs directly (not via producer summary). Ran `mix test test/letflow/engine/variable_merge_test.exs` myself: 16 tests, 0 failures (seed 189604). All 5 ACs plus the whole-batch all-or-nothing semantics and the AC2 nil/%{} equivalence branch each map to >=1 concrete, runnable test in the file (spec's own coverage table cross-checked against the actual test names, all present verbatim). AC4 (validate_payload/3 reuse) is correctly documented as code-inspection-only (not runtime-testable) with its own re-run grep evidence in the spec, following the transition_test.exs precedent -- not a gap. No `@tag :skip` anywhere in the file. No 'TODO: implement test' in the spec (grepped, zero hits). Every test builds its own local `current`/`incoming`/`validations` fixtures inline -- no shared module-level mutable state, no cross-test pollution, each test independently runnable (verified no test references another test's data or ordering). No hardcoded secrets or connection strings (grepped for password/secret/api_key/token=/connstring/postgres:// patterns, zero hits) -- module is pure, no Repo/DB config anywhere. Mutation drill: edited lib/letflow/engine/variable_merge.ex's `find_rejection` rejection branch (merge/3, ~line 161) to also apply `new_keys` inserts into the returned map before returning {:rejected, ...} -- i.e. made the whole-batch all-or-nothing rejection leak the otherwise-unproblematic new-key insert instead of discarding the whole batch. Re-ran the same test file: 16 tests, 1 failure -- caught by exactly 'a batch with both a valid new key and a rejected overwrite key: neither lands' (test/letflow/engine/variable_merge_test.exs:170), asserting unchanged_variables == current failed with left: %{"amount" => 10, "brand_new_key" => "should_never_land"} vs right: %{"amount" => 10} -- exactly the defect this test was designed to catch, and no other test spuriously failed. Reverted the mutation (git diff on the file confirmed empty after revert) and re-ran: 16 tests, 0 failures again, tree clean. All Step 3b checks pass; no gaps found to route back to TEST-DESIGNER.
